title: “I don’t write my plans anymore… the Holy Spirit does.
paragraphs:
“I don’t write my plans anymore… the Holy Spirit does.
I just carry the pen. ✍️🔥”

Every victory, every closed door, every breakthrough — all authored by His hand.
When you surrender your agenda to Heaven, your story becomes a masterpiece.

🎬 THE HOLY SPIRIT WRITES MY AGENDA
#FaithInMotion #ChristianFilmPoster

📖 Bible Verse:
“The steps of a man are established by the Lord, when he delights in His way.”
— Psalm 37:23 (ESV)

🙏 Let this remind you: you’re not just living — you’re being written.
Let Him hold the pen.
